in_marathi.name: Chitrabhanu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitrabhanu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chitrabhanu is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots - 'Chitra' meaning moon-like and 'Bhanu' meaning radiant. This name is associated with Lord Indra, the God of rain and thunder, and is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
